subject: Marketplace addendum: pass-through invoicing, audit criteria, and redline plan
messages:
From: CloudMart Legal <legal@cloudmart.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace reseller addendum — pass-through and audit language

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As we start to get legal counsel aligned on the Marketplace Reseller Addendum, we have three items we need Redwood to confirm or propose language for:

1) Fee pass-through: we need clear language that CloudMart will be billed for marketplace platform fees (payment processor fees, listing fees) and that Redwood will pass those charges through to us on the monthly invoice. Please confirm the exact invoice itemization you can support (line items + gross vs net).

2) Audit trigger and evidence: our procurement team requires an audit clause for pass-through charges when aggregate pass-throughs exceed $250k in a rolling 12 months. We need to understand what evidence Redwood can provide (invoice lineage, backed by Cloud provider invoice or third-party receipts).

3) Order Form redline: we'll send our suggested redlines to the MSA and Order Form (protected carveouts for tax, withholding) — want to know if you object to a 45-day cure period for disputed pass-throughs.

Attached: CloudMart_MPA_redline_requests.pdf (high level asks).

Can you loop in legal and finance at Redwood? We are on a timebox — hope to finalize before your internal EOM freeze on 8/12.

Regards,

Sarah Liu
Director, Partnerships (CloudMart)
legal@cloudmart.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cloudmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace reseller addendum — pass-through and audit language

Hi Sarah — thanks, and appreciate the clear asks. Looping in our finance and legal leads to go through specifics. Quick read ahead from our side and a proposed operational approach: 

- Invoice itemization: we can present pass-through items as separate line items on the monthly invoice (labelled: "Marketplace pass-through — processor fees / listing fees"). We do not currently provide the upstream vendor invoice as a PDF attachment by default, but we can provide a supporting evidence pack on request (see audit plan below).

- Dispute/cure period: 45 days is acceptable as a starting point, but we typically include an initial 30-day informal notice window before formal dispute escalation. If the CloudMart legal team requires 45 days in the contract, we can accept that with a one-time exception for new pass-through types (e.g., taxes).

- Audit evidence: operationally we can provide a time-bound evidence pack: (a) Redwood's internal invoice extract, (b) upstream provider invoice references (IDs + request form), (c) summary reconciliation for the disputed period. For CloudMart to pull a third-party audit, we prefer an agreed SOW for audit scope and sampling thresholds.

Action plan / timeline: 
1) Irene: can you draft a short replacement clause for the MSA and a parallel call-out for the Order Form that limits audit rights to: (i) pass-throughs > $250k in rolling 12 months, (ii) one supplier-level audit per 24 months, and (iii) Redwood providing evidence pack within 20 business days of a valid request?
2) Ben: can you confirm the invoice line-item format and whether finance can turn around requested supporting documents in the 20-business-day window?
3) Marissa (me): I will consolidate and send back to CloudMart with proposed language by Tue 8/3 EOD so you have time before your internal freeze.

Attachments: Redwood_proposal_pass_through.docx (draft operational language), invoice_flow_sketch.png

If this works for CloudMart, we can mark items 1 and 2 as 'accepted in principle' and iterate on exact clause language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace reseller addendum — pass-through and audit language

Thanks for the ping — quick notes from finance: 

- Invoice itemization: we can produce discrete pass-through lines grouped by category (processor fees, listing fees, taxes). Suggested labeling: "Pass-through — [category] (upstream ref: XXXXX)" so CloudMart can reconcile quickly.
- Upstream evidence: upstream provider invoices are often available as billing account PDFs (we can pull those). We will redact any unrelated customer info, but we will include invoice IDs and gross amounts.
- Timing: 20 business days to assemble the evidence pack is reasonable for typical requests (<50 invoices). For large scopes we will request a short SOW and cost-sharing for retrieval effort.
- Commission/crediting: if CloudMart expects any reseller commissions to route differently when a pass-through is disputed, we need to call that out. Proposed fallback: disputed pass-throughs do not affect commission calculations unless a final adjustment is made after reconciliation.

Irene — happy to meet if you want a clause with explicit billing cadence (net-30 vs net-45) tied to pass-throughs.

—Ben
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Proposed redlines and send plan for CloudMart

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the context. I drafted proposed language and callouts below; please review and confirm before I send a tracked-redline to CloudMart. 

Proposed MSA clause (high level):
"Pass-through Charges. Redwood may pass through third-party fees and charges incurred on behalf of Customer that are itemized on the applicable Order Form or invoice (\"Pass-through Charges\"). Redwood shall provide Customer, on request, a reasonable evidence pack consisting of Redwood's invoice extract and references to applicable upstream vendor invoice IDs. Customer's right to audit Pass-through Charges is limited to instances where Pass-through Charges exceed USD 250,000 in aggregate in the preceding 12 months. Any audit shall be of a single, reasonable scope and may not be exercised more than once in any 24-month period. Redwood shall provide the requested evidence pack within twenty (20) business days of a valid written request. Any disputes must be raised within forty-five (45) days of invoice issuance and, if not resolved within thirty (30) days thereafter, may proceed to the dispute resolution process set out in Section X."

Order Form callout: a short paragraph referencing pass-through categories and indicating how they will be itemized on invoices (processor/listing/taxes) and that taxes and statutory withholdings will be handled per applicable law.

Redline approach: send tracked redline to CloudMart with the language above, include the invoice sample and the invoice_flow_sketch.png as an explanatory attachment. Ask for a response by Fri 8/6 EOD so we can make the EOM.

Open questions for Marissa / Ben: 1) confirm 250k threshold and the 20 business day turnaround, 2) confirm whether we want to allow a one-time early exception for newly introduced pass-through types, and 3) confirm whether we will accept 45-day dispute window as contract language (Ben flagged commission callouts).

If you both sign off, I'll send the tracked redline to Sarah and legal@cloudmart.com and propose a 8/6 deadline.

Irene Choi
Head of Contracts, Corporate Legal
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
